---
name: Teaching improvement
about: You understood something in a better way than the course teaches it
title: '[lecture-NN] '
labels: teaching
---

**The idea as the course currently teaches it**: which lecture, which section.

**The better way you saw it**: the picture, the story, the example, or the exercise that made
it click for you. This is the most valuable kind of issue this project receives. Do not worry
about polish; the wording gets workshopped in the PR.

**Would you like to write it?** Either answer is fine. If yes, read CONTRIBUTING.md and the
two model chapters (lecture-01, lecture-02) first.
